title: Reproducibility Software for Numerical Certification and Approximation Benchmarking of an Experimentally Anchored Soft-Core Atom-Ion Radial Hamiltonian
description: Reproducibility source code, tests, and execution metadata supporting numerical certification and fixed-operator approximation benchmarking of an experimentally anchored effective soft-core atom-ion radial Hamiltonian. The archive includes fourth-order finite-difference calculations, continuum extrapolation, Numerov validation, WKB quantization, variational calculations, perturbative-breakdown diagnostics, non-perturbative harmonic-oscillator-basis diagonalization, regulator-dependence analysis, angular-sector diagnostics, and zero-energy boundary calculations. The reported numerical precision characterizes the selected frozen operator and must not be interpreted as comparable physical accuracy for the complete Paul-trap system or its dynamical formation process.
